title: Finite Reference temporal refinement on the six-material fixed-head panel

trigger.reason: Candidate ODE integration uncertainty is separated and the sole B12 storage exception is a floating state-accumulation effect. The next unresolved causal axis is finite Reference temporal discretization.

authority.basis_reason: The immutable B1H coarse Reference trajectories were generated from 1caa4310. The later canonical delta changes no Reference source or solver path used by this laboratory; B1HCK varies only the outer Reference interval on the identical basis.

scope.bottom_boundary: zero prescribed pressure head at fixed 160 cm
scope.candidate_representation: R16_OP equal-grid Layer-ROM only as continuous-time residual comparator

common_observables: QAVG_cm_per_day over each 0.001 d observation interval
QEND_cm_per_day at the common observation endpoint

candidate_oracle.authority_note: B1HCI established independent DOP853/Radau agreement; B1HCJ resolved the only Heun storage exception. No new candidate model is introduced.

metrics: Reference coarse-mid and mid-fine pooled RMS/max-absolute self-differences
Reference apparent order from coarse-mid versus mid-fine RMS where resolvable
DOP853 candidate-to-Reference pooled RMS/max-absolute residual at all three Reference levels
finest unresolved Reference temporal scale divided by candidate-to-fine-Reference residual scale
bottom-flux sign differences between Reference levels

component_classification.SATURATED: coarse-mid and mid-fine RMS are both <= the inherited component numerical floor
component_classification.CONVERGING: mid-fine RMS <= coarse-mid RMS + inherited numerical floor

bounded_if: Every component is SATURATED or CONVERGING.
For every component, Reference mid-fine RMS <= max(inherited numerical floor, 0.10 * DOP853-to-finest-Reference RMS).
material_gate.rationale: The 0.10 factor is inherited from the B1HCI numerical-oracle resolution principle. It is a causal-resolution bound, not hydrological or application acceptance.

interpretation_rules: If all six materials are bounded, finite Reference temporal discretization is too small at the finest tested level to explain the remaining equal-grid candidate-to-Reference residual under the frozen numerical-resolution rule.
A bounded temporal axis does not prove Layer-ROM closure correctness; it isolates the remaining equal-grid discrepancy as model-form/closure/spatial-operator difference on this laboratory.
If any material is not bounded, refine or diagnose only that Reference temporal axis before revisiting closure/state.
Do not use these numerical gates as application tolerances.
